concat.command:
seqkit head -n 3 windows.fa > trio.fa
seqkit subseq -r 1:10 trio.fa > left.fa
seqkit subseq -r -10:-1 trio.fa > right.fa
seqkit concat left.fa right.fa | seqkit sort | seqkit fx2tab -Q -i
concat.output:
human_01	GATCACAGGTGTAAAAAACT
human_02	CCAGTTGACAACAAACCTAC
human_03	CGAGCCTGGTTGTTGGATCA

deduplicate.command:
seqkit head -n 1 windows.fa | seqkit subseq -r 1:20 | seqkit replace -p '^.*$' -r copy > copy.fa
seqkit mutate -p 20:A copy.fa > edited.fa
seqkit replace -p '^copy$' -r other copy.fa > other.fa
cat copy.fa edited.fa other.fa > duplicates.fa
seqkit rmdup -s -P -i duplicates.fa | seqkit fx2tab -Q -i

rename.command:
seqkit head -n 1 windows.fa | seqkit subseq -r 1:20 | seqkit replace -p '^.*$' -r copy > copy.fa
seqkit mutate -p 20:A copy.fa > edited.fa
seqkit replace -p '^copy$' -r other copy.fa > other.fa
cat copy.fa edited.fa other.fa > duplicates.fa
seqkit rename duplicates.fa | seqkit seq -n -i
